title: SkyAttack
description: Experience a completely new way to play Skyblock, with MMO elements and multiplayer systems—all set in the Void!
body:
# ☁️ Sky Attack

**Sky Attack** is a feature-rich Skyblock datapack for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x**.

Start on a tiny island suspended above the void and build your way up from limited resources. With a custom skill system, reworked fishing rewards, custom recipes, and unique progression mechanics, Sky Attack offers its own take on the classic Skyblock experience.

> 🌐 Currently available in **English**. Some untranslated German text may still appear and will be updated in future releases.

---

### 🚧 Active Development

Sky Attack is an actively developed project. While the core gameplay is fully playable, new content, mechanics, and improvements are continuously being added.

⚠️ **Important:** Due to ongoing development, updates may introduce changes that are not compatible with existing worlds. In some cases, updating to a newer version may cause issues or break existing worlds.

Creating regular backups before updating is strongly recommended.

Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are always welcome and help shape future updates.


---

## 🌍 The World

The **Overworld** and **Nether** are completely empty. No terrain, no structures — only the void.

Biomes still exist and affect weather, lighting, mob spawning, and fishing rewards. Be careful when exploring the Nether; there is nothing below you.

---

## ⚙️ Gamerules

| Setting           | Value    |
| ----------------- | -------- |
| Keep Inventory    | Enabled  |
| Difficulty        | Hard     |
| Random Tick Speed | 15       |
| Mob Griefing      | Disabled |

---

## 🎮 Features

### ⛏️ Skill System

Level up different skills while playing:

* Mining
* Fishing
* Farming
* Combat
* Logging

Each skill grants bonuses and improved drops as your level increases.

### 🎣 Reworked Fishing

Fishing is one of the core progression systems in Sky Attack.

* Completely reworked fish, junk, and treasure loot pools
* Many otherwise unobtainable resources can be obtained through fishing
* Special creature spawns can appear while fishing
* Spawned creatures depend on the biome you're fishing in

### 📦 Custom Recipes

Resources that would normally be unavailable in Skyblock can be crafted through custom recipes.

Use the in-game Wiki to discover them.

### 🗺️ In-Game Wiki

Access guides, mechanics, and gameplay information directly in-game through the built-in menu.

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

When joining for the first time, you will spawn in a central hub with an NPC.

Talk to the NPC to create your personal Skyblock island and begin your adventure.

The Minecraft Quick Actions menu (default key: **G**) provides access to:

* The Sky Attack Wiki
* Player statistics (work in progress)
* Teleportation features that expand as you progress

---

## 🔧 Development Status

| System                           | Status         |
| -------------------------------- | -------------- |
| Multiplayer / Island Join System | Finished       |
| Fishing Rewards Expansion        | In Development |
| Nether & End Content             | Planned        |

---

## 📋 Requirements

* Minecraft Java Edition **1.21.11**
* No mods required
* Pure datapack

---

## 💡 Inspirations

Sky Attack takes inspiration from:

* SparkofPhoenix's Elements project
* Hypixel Skyblock

This project is **not** a recreation of Elements. All systems were developed independently and are designed to create a unique Skyblock experience.
